name: PS-OCT Test
summary: Test App that reads a PS-OCT input and prints its config.json; it performs no processing and produces no output.
description: main only reads the psoct input path and prints config.json, then exits. It is a test stub for the neuro/ps-oct datatype and should not be used for analysis.

inputs.description: Polarisation-sensitive OCT data (channel 1, channel 2 and retardance images).
